`GeoIP2-Country-Test.mmdb` is a synthetic test database from
[MaxMind-DB](https://github.com/maxmind/MaxMind-DB/blob/276926d23b4109ca5452709bfb5931c338afb34c/test-data/GeoIP2-Country-Test.mmdb),
revision `276926d23b4109ca5452709bfb5931c338afb34c`.

It is distributed under the accompanying `LICENSE-MIT`. It is a test fixture,
not a production GeoIP database. Tests use it locally without network access.
